rules.title: Suspicious bulk sensitive-record access
rules.logic: Five or more successful sensitive-data reads by one actor within ten minutes.
rules.false_positive_notes: Reporting, migration, and support workflows can produce high read volume. Verify approval, schedule, role, and data-access purpose before containment.
rules.tuning_notes: Replace the lab threshold with role and workflow baselines before production use.

rules.title: Privileged-account authentication anomaly
rules.logic: Five failed privileged-account sign-ins in five minutes followed by a success for the same actor from a new source IP within fifteen minutes.
rules.false_positive_notes: Confirm identity-provider retries, approved travel, support access, and source-IP ownership before declaring compromise.
rules.tuning_notes: Use known-device, MFA, conditional-access, and account-risk data when available.

rules.title: Kubernetes admission policy denied unsafe workload
rules.logic: An admission policy denies an unsafe workload in a production namespace.
rules.false_positive_notes: A blocked development deployment can be expected. Validate target namespace, policy, and change record.
rules.tuning_notes: Alert on repeated denials or denials involving privileged containers, unsigned images, or production service accounts.

rules.title: Unapproved interactive Kubernetes execution
rules.logic: Interactive execution in production without break-glass approval; elevate to critical when a runtime shell or unapproved egress signal correlates within five minutes.
rules.false_positive_notes: Approved break-glass maintenance and permitted SRE diagnostics must have a ticket, time limit, and named owner.
rules.tuning_notes: Maintain a short-lived approved-maintenance allowlist rather than a permanent account exclusion.
